properties.description: No reachable state is explicitly unsafe.
Every paid state has successful payment evidence.
A cancelled order cannot contain a successful charge.
FAILED is used only when no successful charge exists.
Payment and cancellation never own the critical resource simultaneously.
Every declared state is reachable from CREATED.
Every state documents detection, solution and next state for each incident.
Ignoring explicitly marked stutter retries, every reachable state inevitably reaches a terminal state.

state_response_matrix.detection: Preconditions and invariants for the normal transition hold
state_response_matrix.solution: Load server prices, validate quantities and reserve inventory.

state_response_matrix.event_or_problem: Invalid input, missing product or insufficient stock
state_response_matrix.detection: Validator and server-side product lookup reject the request
state_response_matrix.solution: Reject atomically; do not persist the order or reserve inventory

state_response_matrix.detection: Database operation throws or transaction aborts
state_response_matrix.solution: Rollback and return a retryable error without creating an order

state_response_matrix.detection: Preconditions and invariants for the normal transition hold
state_response_matrix.solution: Persist order and items in the same transaction.

state_response_matrix.event_or_problem: Overflow or total mismatch discovered before commit
state_response_matrix.detection: Checked arithmetic or total equality assertion fails
state_response_matrix.solution: Rollback the transaction and release the reservation

state_response_matrix.event_or_problem: Persistence fails after inventory was reserved
state_response_matrix.detection: Save or commit fails
state_response_matrix.solution: Rollback all order and stock changes

state_response_matrix.detection: Preconditions and invariants for the normal transition hold
state_response_matrix.solution: Acquire the per-order transaction lock and record the idempotency key.

state_response_matrix.event_or_problem: Customer cancels before the gateway charge
state_response_matrix.detection: Cancellation wins the serialized state update
state_response_matrix.solution: Cancel the order and release reserved inventory

state_response_matrix.event_or_problem: Duplicate request with the same idempotency key
state_response_matrix.detection: Existing key is found for the order
state_response_matrix.solution: Return the existing in-progress result and create no second payment

state_response_matrix.event_or_problem: Payment amount differs from the server total
state_response_matrix.detection: Request amount is not equal to Order.TotalAmount
state_response_matrix.solution: Reject the payment; keep the order payable with the correct amount

state_response_matrix.detection: Preconditions and invariants for the normal transition hold
state_response_matrix.solution: Persist one SUCCESS payment and transition the order atomically.

state_response_matrix.event_or_problem: Gateway timeout or transient network error
state_response_matrix.detection: No authenticated final response before timeout
state_response_matrix.solution: Release the lock and enter a bounded retry state using the same idempotency key

state_response_matrix.detection: Authenticated final decline response
state_response_matrix.solution: Mark the flow failed and release inventory

state_response_matrix.event_or_problem: Gateway charged but local database commit failed
state_response_matrix.detection: Payment remains PROCESSING while the gateway has a final result for the idempotency key
state_response_matrix.solution: Reconcile the existing charge by idempotency key; never create another logical payment

state_response_matrix.detection: Cancellation observes payment lock or changed row version
state_response_matrix.solution: Serialize the operations; cancellation retries after the payment result

state_response_matrix.detection: Preconditions and invariants for the normal transition hold
state_response_matrix.solution: Use the final bounded attempt with the same idempotency key.

state_response_matrix.event_or_problem: Retry budget is exhausted while the gateway outcome remains unknown
state_response_matrix.detection: Bounded retry counter reaches its configured maximum without a final gateway result
state_response_matrix.solution: Stop automatic charging, keep inventory reserved and require reconciliation/manual review

state_response_matrix.event_or_problem: Customer cancels while no confirmed charge exists
state_response_matrix.detection: Gateway reconciliation confirms no successful charge
state_response_matrix.solution: Cancel and release inventory

state_response_matrix.detection: Preconditions and invariants for the normal transition hold
state_response_matrix.solution: Persist one SUCCESS payment and transition the order atomically.

state_response_matrix.detection: Authenticated final decline proves no charge succeeded
state_response_matrix.solution: Mark failed and release inventory

state_response_matrix.event_or_problem: Final attempt times out with an unknown outcome
state_response_matrix.detection: No authenticated final response is available
state_response_matrix.solution: Stop charging automatically and continue reconciliation/manual review without releasing inventory

state_response_matrix.event_or_problem: Final attempt charged but local commit failed
state_response_matrix.detection: Payment remains PROCESSING while the gateway has a final result
state_response_matrix.solution: Reconcile the existing charge; do not increase the charge attempt counter

state_response_matrix.detection: Preconditions and invariants for the normal transition hold
state_response_matrix.solution: Confirm fulfillment and preserve the successful payment evidence.

state_response_matrix.event_or_problem: Duplicate success callback or client retry
state_response_matrix.detection: The order already has a SUCCESS payment for the idempotency key
state_response_matrix.solution: Return the original payment; do not insert or charge again

state_response_matrix.detection: Fulfillment confirmation fails with a retryable error
state_response_matrix.solution: Keep PAID and retry confirmation without charging again

state_response_matrix.event_or_problem: Order cannot be fulfilled after payment
state_response_matrix.detection: Permanent inventory or fulfillment failure
state_response_matrix.solution: Start compensation; never silently change PAID to FAILED

state_response_matrix.detection: Preconditions and invariants for the normal transition hold
state_response_matrix.solution: Persist confirmation.

state_response_matrix.detection: Bounded confirmation retry counter reaches its limit
state_response_matrix.solution: Escalate to compensating refund

state_response_matrix.detection: Preconditions and invariants for the normal transition hold
state_response_matrix.solution: Close the successful order.

state_response_matrix.detection: The order cannot be delivered
state_response_matrix.solution: Start a refund and release inventory when compensation completes

state_response_matrix.detection: Preconditions and invariants for the normal transition hold
state_response_matrix.solution: Persist refund evidence and release inventory.

state_response_matrix.detection: No authenticated final refund result
state_response_matrix.solution: Retry or query with the same refund idempotency key and alert operations

state_response_matrix.event_or_problem: Late duplicate callback or state-change request
state_response_matrix.detection: Order is already terminal
state_response_matrix.solution: Return the stored result, reject state mutation and audit the event

state_response_matrix.detection: Order is terminal CANCELLED
state_response_matrix.solution: Reject the charge/state mutation and raise an alert if the gateway reports money captured

state_response_matrix.detection: Order is terminal FAILED
state_response_matrix.solution: Reject mutation; require a new order rather than reviving this one

state_response_matrix.detection: Refund transaction is already final
state_response_matrix.solution: Return the original refund result and do not refund twice

negative_scenarios.description: A cancelled order is revived and paid.
A mismatched amount is accepted as paid.
Two successful payments are persisted for one order.
Payment and cancellation enter their critical sections together.

interpretation.scope: Exhaustive over the finite declared model only
interpretation.fairness: AF_TERMINAL_FAIR removes only transitions explicitly marked stutter
interpretation.limitation: A PASS does not prove the ASP.NET implementation conforms to this model
